messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
What is the deadline by which Member States must, for the first time, supply the data and information specified in Article 6(5) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: Qual è la scadenza entro la quale gli Stati membri devono, per la prima volta, fornire i dati e le informazioni specificati all'articolo 6, paragrafo 5, del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230?
